rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something awkward and difficult to operate because it has small or inconvenient parts.

example.english: The buttons on this machine are so fiddly.
example.traditional: 呢部機啲掣咁細，好難搞。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 di1 zai3 gam3 sai3 hou2 naan4 gaau2

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the task requires dexterity, precision, or skilled handwork rather than merely being inconvenient.

example.traditional: 呢幅十字繡針針都要對準，真係好考手工。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 sap6 zi6 sau3 zam1 zam1 dou1 jiu3 deoi3 zeon2 zan1 hai6 hou2 haau2 sau2 gung1
